reason: The packet records executed English and Chinese searches and a Jilin platform municipal extent for the unchanged WUP point, but no cadastral layer, native ID or full polygon. Its Chinese query uses 玉树市 while the claimed Jilin municipality is 榆树市; this name ambiguity remains a research gap. Independent retries of the platform region and query-configuration endpoints returned HTTP 403, so the worker's HTTP 200 contents could not be reproduced from original response artifacts in this review. These access outcomes and municipal extent do not establish parcel absence or admission.
